name: Intelligence
vision_statement: Each request is understood against what the person is working toward.
opportunities: Which request deserves which handling changes as models and the person's intents change, so each part of handling a request is a swappable solution with its own measure.
solution_coherence: Intelligence turns one request into a response. Quest Intents says which of the person's quests the request serves and what the work is for. Subconscious prepares what the request needs before it is asked for. Mind thinks the request through step by step. Nervous System watches the run and brings in a person only where only a person can decide. Critical Thinking holds the work to the measure that serves the person's goals, and hands work nobody asked for to Quest Autopilot, which starts it only when the person allows.
